choice_prompt:2:1711153001.text: Wait, wait! Lord Merlin! Mage Costi, I've told you everything I know... Why did you bring me here?!
choice_prompt:2:1711153001.source_cn: 等、等等！梅林阁下！科斯蒂魔法师，我已经把知道的都说了……你们为什么要把我带到这里？！

say:4:1711153003:1.text: Finally, there's that unfinished thesis that involves Orion, Germwen, and you...
say:4:1711153003:1.source_cn: 最后，是那牵扯到奥利安、格墨文和你的未完成论文……

choice_prompt:6:1711153004.text: These are just routine external resource coordination... I was only responsible for liaison; I absolutely did not participate in those crazy experiments!
choice_prompt:6:1711153004.source_cn: 这、 这些只是常规的外部资源统筹……我只负责对接，我绝对没有参与那些疯狂的实验！

say:9:1711153007:1.text: No! I didn't kill Emerson! Lord Merlin, I swear!
say:9:1711153007:1.source_cn: 不！我没有杀埃摩森！梅林大人，我发誓！

say:12:1711153010:1.text: If I don't do as instructed, I'll be the experimental subject!
say:12:1711153010:1.source_cn: 如果我不照做，实验材料就会是我！

say:14:1711153011:1.text: Coward. You just stand by and watch your colleague's magic be drained, all to keep your own position?
say:14:1711153011:1.source_cn: 懦夫。你为了保住自己的位置，就眼睁睁看着同僚被抽干魔力？

choice_prompt:15:1711153011.text: Coward. You just stand by and watch your colleague's magic be drained, all to keep your own position?
choice_prompt:15:1711153011.source_cn: 懦夫。你为了保住自己的位置，就眼睁睁看着同僚被抽干魔力？

say:16:1711153012:1.text: I... I still have something to say! Lord Merlin!
say:16:1711153012:1.source_cn: 我、我还有东西可以交代！梅林大人！

choice:15:0:1.text: This known intelligence is not enough.

choice:15:1:2.text: If this is all the value you have...
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 如果这是你全部的价值……

choice:6:0:1.text: Is Emerson's death really unrelated to you?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 埃摩森的死真的与你无关？

choice:6:1:2.text: You dare say you don't know about Deergray's research?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你敢说你不知道迪尔格雷的研究？

choice:2:0:1.text: Your testimony is full of loopholes.

choice:2:1:2.text: Don't be nervous, we're helping you remember more.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 别紧张，我们在帮助你回忆更多

choice:2:2:3.text: Stop spouting your lies about not knowing the truth.
choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 收起你不知情的鬼话吧
